workflows.title: How to upgrade a client's plan

steps.text: Select Upgrade on the client detail page to move that client onto the enterprise plan.
Select Delete on the client detail page to start removing the client.
Select Rename on the client detail page to save the client's new name.
Choose New client on the Clients page to start creating a client.
A New client dialog opens for you to enter the client's details.
Fill in the client's name, billing email and plan in the form.
Select Create client to save the new client.

workflows.title: How to export CSV from clients list

steps.text: On the Clients page, select "Export CSV" to export the client list.
Type into the search box on the Clients page to narrow the list of clients.
The clients table lists your clients in rows on the Clients page.

workflows.title: How to client list access message

steps.text: If you lack access to the client list, the table area shows the message "You do not have access to the client list."

workflows.title: How to new client button on the dashboard

steps.text: Start creating a client from the dashboard by selecting "New client".
Select "Clear selection" above the invoice list to drop the currently selected invoice.

workflows.title: How to open an invoice from the list

steps.text: Select an invoice by pressing the open button on its row in the invoice list.
The Settings page includes a separate Danger Zone section for risky, hard-to-undo actions.
Fill in the settings fields, then submit the form to save your changes.

workflows.title: How to new API key display

steps.text: The new API key appears on the Settings page in the danger zone after rotating the key.
Select "Rotate API key" in the Settings danger zone to issue a new API key.
